dct_description_sm: This is a listing of all on-farm / rural business official plan amendments from the years 2005 – 2014. The basis for this data being zoning and official plan amendments, so it does not necessarily capture on-farm business applications for those properties within the Niagara Escarpment Plan area. This data helped serve as the background for the County’s recent on-farm business study done by planning students from Waterloo.
